Those [few Catholics] in Calhoun, Campbullton, Covington, Griffin, Kingston, La Grange, Newman, Pleasant Valley, Tunnell Hill, &c., are at present in charge of the Pastor of Atlanta also.
﻿A new Church is about to be built here on a lot given by Benj. H. Green, Esq.
